articles.title: Scaffolding KiCad-MCP-Bridge: How We Built a Distributed AI PCB Engine (And Solved the Lab Security Problem)
articles.excerpt: What if you could sit with your thin MacBook Air in a university coffee shop or library, type a prompt into an autonomous AI agent like Antigravity or Claude Code, and watch as a high-performance work…
articles.body: What if you could sit with your thin MacBook Air in a university coffee shop or library, type a prompt into an autonomous AI agent like Antigravity or Claude Code , and watch as a high-performance workstation across the room or down the hall autonomously designs, routes, and validates a custom PCB in KiCad 8/9 ? No clunky remote desktop lag. No installing gigabytes of CAD libraries, C++ wrappers, and heavy GPU drivers on your lightweight laptop. Just pure, deterministic, agentic hardware engineering over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) . That was the mission behind KiCad-MCP-Bridge . In this article, I will walk you through: The Architectural Topology : Bridging an MCP client laptop to a remote KiCad host over direct Thunderbolt 4 / USB4 links and high-speed networks.
articles.author: Pavan Kumar Sadashiv

articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 42 · Chapter 09 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_42_AI_Safety_Alignment_and_Interpretability/blob/main/Chapter_09_Experiments_and_Benchmarks/Chapter_09_Experiments_and_Benchmarks_KR.md Volume 42. AI Safety Alignment and Interpretability 09. Experiments and Benchmarks 09.01 Safety Benchmarks 안전성 벤치마크(Safety Benchmarks)는 인공지능(Artificial Intelligence, AI) 시스템이 까다로운 운영 조건에서도 신뢰성(Reliability), 예측 가능성(Predictability), 보안성(Security)을 유지하는지 체계적으로 평가하는 방법을 제공한다. 정확도(Accuracy)나 계산 효율성(Computational Efficiency)을 강조하는 기존 성능 벤치마크와 달리, 안전성 벤치마크는 실패 동작(Failure Behavior), 적대적 취약성(Adversarial Vulnerability), 불확실성(Uncertainty), 운영 위험(Operational Risk)을 분석한다. 주요 목적은 실제 환경에서 심각한 문제가 발생하기 전에 시스템의 한계를 식별하는 것이다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: AI Safety Alignment and Interpretability — Ch.08: Engineering and Deployment [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Volume 42 · Chapter 08 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_42_AI_Safety_Alignment_and_Interpretability/blob/main/Chapter_08_Engineering_and_Deployment/Chapter_08_Engineeri…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 42 · Chapter 08 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_42_AI_Safety_Alignment_and_Interpretability/blob/main/Chapter_08_Engineering_and_Deployment/Chapter_08_Engineering_and_Deployment_KR.md Volume 42. AI Safety Alignment and Interpretability 08. Engineering and Deployment 08.01 Safety Pipeline [w/Code] 안전 파이프라인(Safety Pipeline)은 인공지능(Artificial Intelligence, AI) 시스템이 개발, 검증, 배포 및 운영의 전체 과정에서 정의된 안전 요구사항(Safety Requirements)을 충족하도록 보장하기 위한 체계적인 엔지니어링 절차(Engineering Process)를 제공한다. 안전을 최종 검사 단계로 취급하는 대신, 위험 평가(Risk Assessment), 데이터 검증(Data Verification), 모델 평가(Model Evaluation), 보안 테스트(Security Testing), 운영 통제(Operational Controls)를 지속적인 생명주기(Lifecycle)에 통합한다. 각 단계에서는 배포 결정과 향후 시스템 개선을 뒷받침하는 검증 근거(Evidence)를 생성한다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: AI Safety Alignment and Interpretability — Ch.07: Advanced Safety and Alignment [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Volume 42 · Chapter 07 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_42_AI_Safety_Alignment_and_Interpretability/blob/main/Chapter_07_Advanced_Safety_and_Alignment/Chapter_07_Advanc…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 42 · Chapter 07 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_42_AI_Safety_Alignment_and_Interpretability/blob/main/Chapter_07_Advanced_Safety_and_Alignment/Chapter_07_Advanced_Safety_and_Alignment_KR.md Volume 42. AI Safety Alignment and Interpretability 07. Advanced Safety and Alignment 07.01 AI Risk and AGI Safety 인공지능 위험(AI Risk)은 인공지능(AI) 시스템이 기술적 결함(Technical Failures), 의도하지 않은 행동(Unintended Behavior), 오용(Misuse), 복잡한 환경과의 상호작용(Interactions with Complex Environments)을 통해 유해한 결과를 초래할 가능성을 포괄한다. 인공지능의 역량이 범용 인공지능(Artificial General Intelligence, AGI)으로 확장됨에 따라 안전 공학(Safety Engineering)은 개별 모델의 오류뿐 아니라 자율적 의사결정(Autonomous Decision-Making), 적응적 행동(Adaptive Behavior), 광범위한 배포(Widespread Deployment)에서 발생하는 시스템적 위험(Systemic Risks)까지 다루어야 한다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: AI Safety Alignment and Interpretability — Ch.06: Governance and Societal Impact [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Volume 42 · Chapter 06 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_42_AI_Safety_Alignment_and_Interpretability/blob/main/Chapter_06_Governance_and_Societal_Impact/Chapter_06_Gover…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 42 · Chapter 06 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_42_AI_Safety_Alignment_and_Interpretability/blob/main/Chapter_06_Governance_and_Societal_Impact/Chapter_06_Governance_and_Societal_Impact_KR.md Volume 42. AI Safety Alignment and Interpretability 06. Governance and Societal Impact 06.00 Overview 인공지능 거버넌스(AI Governance)는 인공지능 시스템(AI Systems)을 책임 있게 개발하고 배포하기 위해 필요한 제도적(Institutional), 기술적(Technical), 조직적(Organizational) 메커니즘을 확립한다. 지능형 기술(Intelligent Technologies)이 경제 활동, 공공 서비스(Public Services), 물리적 환경(Physical Environments)에 점점 더 큰 영향을 미치면서, 거버넌스는 인공지능 전체 생명주기(AI Lifecycle)에 걸쳐 안전성(Safety), 책임성(Accountability), 투명성(Transparency), 공정성(Fairness), 인간 감독(Human Oversight)을 다루어야 한다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: AI Safety Alignment and Interpretability — Ch.05: Robustness and Security [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Volume 42 · Chapter 05 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_42_AI_Safety_Alignment_and_Interpretability/blob/main/Chapter_05_Robustness_and_Security/Chapter_05_Robustness_a…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 42 · Chapter 05 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_42_AI_Safety_Alignment_and_Interpretability/blob/main/Chapter_05_Robustness_and_Security/Chapter_05_Robustness_and_Security_KR.md Volume 42. AI Safety Alignment and Interpretability 05. Robustness and Security 05.00 Overview 견고성(Robustness)과 보안성(Security)은 불확실하고 동적이며 잠재적으로 적대적인 환경(Adversarial Environment)에서 작동하는 인공지능(Artificial Intelligence, AI) 시스템의 핵심 요구사항이다. 견고성은 입력, 운영 조건 또는 환경적 가정이 변화하더라도 모델이 허용 가능한 성능을 유지하는 능력을 의미한다. 보안성은 시스템의 무결성(Integrity), 기밀성(Confidentiality), 가용성(Availability)을 침해하는 의도적인 조작, 무단 접근 및 공격으로부터 AI 시스템을 보호하는 데 중점을 둔다. 현대 AI 시스템은 통제된 평가 환경에서 높은 정확도를 달성하지만, 익숙하지 않은 입력이나 의도적인 간섭에 노출되면 예상하지 못한 실패를 보이기도 한다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: AI Safety Alignment and Interpretability — Ch.04: Fairness and Bias [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Volume 42 · Chapter 04 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_42_AI_Safety_Alignment_and_Interpretability/blob/main/Chapter_04_Fairness_and_Bias/Chapter_04_Fairness_and_Bias_…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 42 · Chapter 04 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_42_AI_Safety_Alignment_and_Interpretability/blob/main/Chapter_04_Fairness_and_Bias/Chapter_04_Fairness_and_Bias_KR.md Volume 42. AI Safety Alignment and Interpretability 04. Fairness and Bias 04.00 Overview 공정성(Fairness)과 편향(Bias)은 자동화 시스템(Automated Systems)이 개인, 조직, 사회에 영향을 미치는 의사결정(Decision-Making)에 점점 더 많이 관여하면서 인공지능(Artificial Intelligence)의 핵심적인 문제로 부상하고 있다. 공정성은 개인과 집단에 대한 공평한 대우를 의미하며, 편향은 정당화되지 않은 결과 차이를 발생시킬 수 있는 체계적인 패턴을 의미한다. 이러한 개념을 이해하는 것은 신뢰성과 책임성을 갖춘 사회적으로 책임 있는 인공지능 시스템을 개발하는 데 필수적이다. 인공지능 시스템(AI Systems)은 데이터(Data)에서 패턴을 학습하고 이를 예측(Prediction), 추천(Recommendation), 의사결정(Decision)으로 변환한다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: 27 Years Later, Science-Fiction's Groundbreaking 4-Part Saga Is Free to Watch on Streaming

articles.body: Some science fiction franchises are so ambitious they become their own cinematic languages. Star Wars built an entire galaxy with a mythology that’s still growing almost 50 years later, while Blade Runner helped define the vision of a far-future Los Angeles through rampant tech advancement and unchecked capitalism. They’re the kinds of franchises that can change the way we imagine the future, influencing everything from fashion and technology to the stories other filmmakers want to tell. Plenty of franchises have tried to capture that same vibe, but few have managed to pull it off quite like The Matrix .

articles.body: Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after he admitted to having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The tech giant's board confirmed the news in a statement today, saying that it is looking into its concerns "in light of recent reporting" that Huang has "been the target of a foreign intelligence effort." The update follows a late-October New York Times report , which stated the CEO had been unfaithful to his wife with an individual that U.S. intelligence believed to be involved in a Chinese spy plot. The individual named in the report as having a relationship with Huang was Megaspeed executive and Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang or Huang Le. The CEO confirmed the affair in a letter sent to Nvidia staff (via BBC ).

articles.title: Legendary sci-fi magazine 'Starlog' returns as a yearly release, just in time for its 50th anniversary
articles.excerpt: Before the rise of online entertainment sites, this is where genre fans got their news
articles.body: "Starlog" was one of the greatest sci-fi and fantasy magazines ever, and after a 17-year absence, it's being resurrected. The legendary sci-fi mag went dark back in 2009 as part of the wave of popular publications folding due to years of declining readership and subscriptions. But as of Nov. 13, this geek favorite periodical returns as an annual print edition, and it's available for pre-order now. It’s another indication of digital fatigue in the world, and fans of a certain age will recall the pleasure of poring over each colorful issue packed with in-depth interviews, behind-the-scenes photos, TV guides, classic movie retrospectives, book reviews, con news, and VFX features. The triumphant relaunch of "Starlog" magazine happens on Nov.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 8, 2005: Europe launches Venus Express, its first mission to Venus
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. Here's why Venus Express mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. The spacecraft was called Venus Express. Venus is a hothouse planet, one where the atmospheric pressure can easily crush an unprotected spacecraft. Even from orbit, Venus Express had to survive harsh radiation. But the spacecraft lasted for more than nine years. During that time, Venus Express saw a weird vortex swirling around Venus's south pole . It also saw possible signs of active volcanoes . Venus Express also discovered that the planet generates its own auroras . These auroras happen when particles from the sun hit charged particles in the atmosphere. Late in the Venus Express mission, controllers told the spacecraft to dip down into Venus's clouds — even though the spacecraft wasn't designed to do this.

articles.title: Scientists simulate an Earth without life to help hunt for aliens and inhabited worlds
articles.excerpt: By modeling how a planet without life develops its atmosphere, astronomers hope to be able to better distinguish rocky planets without life from those that are inhabited.
articles.body: A new computer simulation that depicts Earth, or a rocky planet in general, without life is the latest tool in the quest to discover whether or not we are alone in the universe. Life leaves its mark on a planet, particularly its atmosphere, in the form of a mixture of biochemically created gases. Some are obvious, while others can be produced by both biology and geology, meaning that distinguishing a planet that has life from one that does not, solely based on what gases we can detect in its atmosphere, can be difficult. The key is in knowing which atmospheric conditions can be explained without life.
